title: Crewday: Site Log

candidates.name: Crewday: Site Log
candidates.why: Carrier plus measured job nouns (site, daily log/report) keeps search hooks while the coined half avoids the bare category title.

candidates.name: Crewday
candidates.why: Crew + day names the daily crew report without saying Daily Report; two syllables, one spelling, room for a job noun in every declared locale.

candidates.name: Daycrew
candidates.why: Same roots as Crewday but reads less like a product name and more like a phrase reversal.

candidates.name: Sitefolio Log
candidates.why: Suggests an assembled site document, but echoes another open proposal's -folio pattern and is harder to spell on first hearing.

candidates.name: Daily Report
candidates.why: Negative control: the bare category phrase already used by Construction Daily Report and Construction Daily Reports App on the measured shelf.

rejected.name: Daily Report
rejected.reason: Bare category noun already carried by multiple measured incumbents; spends Play's strongest ranking field on a head term we cannot own.

rejected.name: Daycrew
rejected.reason: Same coinage family as Crewday but weaker job-fit and searchability; Crewday: Site Log keeps the clearer carrier.

rejected.name: Sitefolio Log
rejected.reason: Near-echo of the open Scorefolio naming pattern and a weaker radio test than Crewday.

audience: Solo GCs, foremen and small-crew leads who write a site daily report and need captioned photos plus a PDF they can send to the office.
rationale: MEASURED — the shelf titles use Construction Daily Report, Construction Daily Log and Site Diary; Crewday avoids those exact phrases as the head title while Site Log retains the job noun for listing and search.
collisionCheck: UNVERIFIED — no trademark-register or dedicated Crewday Play collision screen has been run; this is not clearance.
localisationCheck: INFERRED — en-US title "Crewday: Site Log" is 16 characters (14 slack under Play's 30); ru-RU "Crewday: дневник" is 17 characters with slack; Latin carrier survival in Cyrillic search is unmeasured.

scoringRubric.floor: chosen >= 70 with no dimension below 2.5; a hard collision check outranks the score

assumptionsUnverified: Crewday has not been searched in trademark registers or a dedicated Play collision screen.
No observed data says a coined carrier outperforms a descriptive Site Diary title for this shelf.
